detector._note: Keypoints 11-13-15 / 12-14-16 (shoulder-elbow-wrist), 3D world angle. A rep opens to 170-180 and closes to 20-30: TOP at >=170, BOTTOM at <=30, 25 is full depth.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, arms straight down (170°+), elbows tucked to your sides.
cues.tooHigh: Curl all the way up — elbow closed to 30° or less.
cues.tooFast: Slow the curl and squeeze at the top.
cues.framing: I can't see your elbows — step back.
